title: It’s All Relative: Interpretable Models for Scoring Bias in Documents

bias_targets.methodology: Training a discrete-choice model with word embeddings on pairs of Wikipedia article revisions (before and after Neutral Point of View edits) to predict and score relative inappropriate subjectivity at the document and word levels.
Applying the trained model to score news articles and evaluating the aggregated bias scores across news outlets with known left, right, and center political leanings.
